race.description: Wittens Irrigation And Design F&M Hcp (C1)
race.comment: ROK 'N' ROM (1) has tackled a 1MW at Ascot at both runs this campaign, finishing second to God's Gate before leading to the turn and finishing seventh to Have A Crack, beaten just under three lengths. That form reads strongly for a race like this and now out in trip with Pike on, she makes the most appeal. TORA BORA (3) was a sharp improver first-up at Albany, running second in CL2 grade at big odds. She turned in a strong figure there and now out to 1400m second-up, everything points to a repeat showing. SHENTON ROAD (10) has yet to win but has placed twice from three starts at around 1400m, and her half-length third to Hamadryad two starts back reads well enough to offset a plain last-start effort at this track. EUTHYMIC (7) is the new element, a $55,000 yearling purchase for a capable debut stable, with first-time blinkers and a recent trial at this venue suggesting she can run a cheeky race. LUNA ASCENDING (8) won't be far away out in trip.
